ensure_correct_mise_install

▸ Trusting mise config
mise trust --yes $APP/.mise.toml
mise trusted $APP

▸ Installing system packages
brew bundle --file=$APP/Brewfile

▸ Installing Ruby and tools
mise install --yes

▸ Installing Git pre-commit hooks
git config core.hooksPath .githooks

▸ Installing RubyGems
bundle install

▸ Trusting SaaS mise overlay
mise trust --yes $APP/mise.saas.toml
mise trusted $APP

▸ Syncing docker-dev
env MISE_ENV=saas mise bootstrap --only repos --yes

▸ Starting mysql
$HOME/Work/basecamp/docker-dev/setup mysql84

▸ Installing the cell's RubyGems
env -u RUBYOPT -u RUBYLIB -u BUNDLER_SETUP -u BUNDLER_VERSION -u BUNDLE_BIN_PATH -u BUNDLE_LOCKFILE BUNDLE_GEMFILE=$APP/saas/hotcell/Gemfile bundle install

▸ Skipping the cell's image (saas/hotcell/build is not here)

rails db:prepare
